description:
@KobirDocumentary  বান্দরবান ভ্রমণের সবকিছু এক ভিডিওতে | Nilgiri Bandarban | Chimbuk pahar | Bandarban Tourist Spot || Nilgiri is located on the top of a hill, just 45 kilometers from the Bandarban district headquarters. If you want to fulfill your desire to touch the clouds, you have to go to Nilgiri in Bandarban. Here the clouds themselves will come and catch you in your hands, playing with rafts of white clouds in the blue sky above your head, creating a beautiful landscape in the Nilgiri hills. The natural beauty of Nilgiri will fascinate you. On the way to Nilgiri, you will see the beautiful waterfalls of Bandarban. Here, tribal forest girls will welcome you. You can buy various products made by tribal people from here. During the rainy season, the waterfall takes on its unique beauty, which fascinates the tourists who come here. Chimbuk Hill or Black Hill is the third largest hill in the country and a historical site located in Bandarban district of Chittagong, Bangladesh. It is located about 2500 feet above mean sea level. It is the queen of hilly beauty of Bangladesh and is also known as the Darjeeling of Bengal. It is located ninety-two kilometers from the village and about 26 kilometers from the Bandarban district town. Titanic View Point is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Bandarban. It looks like the Titanic ship from a distance. From here, you can enjoy the vast view of the mountains, the cloud-covered environment, and the natural beauty of the river. Another beautiful tourist spot in Bandarban is the Double Hand View Point. This spot has been created in such a way that it looks like two hands have been deliberately extended. Usually, there is no easy way to enter these spots. Those who come here are busy taking pictures. Nilgiri is a hill and tourist center located in Bandarban district of Bangladesh. Nilgiri is called the Darjeeling hill of Bangladesh. It is about 50 kilometers away from the Bandarban district headquarters. The height of the hill is 2,200 feet. Nilgiri Hills is one of the most beautiful tourist centers in Bangladesh. Nilgiri Tourism Center. Due to its location at an altitude of about 2200 feet above sea level, the Nilgiri tourist center is always covered in clouds, which is the special attraction of this tourist center. Since the beginning of the 21st century, the Nilgiri has gradually become known as a tourist center to people across the country.
